author: @neomyy149
text:
Di tahun 2023 akhirnya beraniin diri buat balik lagi nonton ini. 

Hai NCT makasih udah buat banyak kenangan manis di tahun 2020, makasih udah bekerja keras selama ini, makasih udah jadi NCT yang sukses. Aku harap kedepannya kalian selalu bahagia, dimanapun dan kapanpun. Aku harap kalian selalu sehat ditengah-tengah banyaknya aktivitas. Aku harap kalian bisa sukses baik grup maupun individu. Sayang se-sayang sayangnya ke kalian, 23 orang yang udah berjuang dari debut sampai di tahun 2020 lalu, dan sampai sekarang. 

Untuk 3 orang yang sekarang udah punya jalan nya masing-masing, juga sukses selalu buat kalian, aku selalu dukung kalian dimanapun itu, dan aku bakal selalu inget kalo kalian pernah jadi bagian dari NCT💚

author: @neomyy149
text:
Hai Taeyong

Terimakasih sudah menjadi leader yang kuat untuk NCT 127 dan NCT. Terimakasih sudah banyak berkembang dari debut sampai sekarang. Terimakasih sudah bekerja sangat keras untuk NCT. Walaupun aku belum kenal kamu pas awal debut, dan bisa dibilang aku ga tau perjuangan kamu sesulit apa dulu, tapi aku bangga banget sama kamu. Kamu leader terhebat, terkuat, pokoknya ter ter dehh💚
Sehat sehat leader hebat. Banyak orang yang sayang kamu💚

Hai Johnny, Our Chicago boyy

Terimakasih sudah merantau jauh ke korea untuk debut sebagai NCT, terimakasih sudah bertahan sampai saat ini, dan terimakasih sudah bekerja sangat keras sampai detik ini. Jaga kesehatan ya, sayang Johnny banyak banyakkk💚

Terimakasih sudah debut sebagai member NCT dan menjadi anak rantau yang jauh dari rumah. Terimakasih sudah banyak bekerja keras untuk NCT. Terimakasih untuk sudah menjadi nakamoto yuta yang kami kenal. Aku suka vokal Yuta, kapan kapan cover lagu lagi yaa💚 
Sehat selalu Na Yuta💚

author: @neomyy149
text:
Hai Kun, bias aku❤️

Terimakasih sudah merantau jauh dari rumah untuk debut menjadi member NCT dan juga leader WayV. Terimakasih sudah menjadi Qian Kun yang amat sangat kuat, talented, etc. Terimakasih sudah berkerja dengan sangat keras sampai detik ini. Kamu juga salah satu leader yang hebat, WayV bisa sukses karena kamu juga. Terimakasih karena sudah memotivasi aku untuk 'menjadi seperti Qian Kun'. text: I've been feeling bad, I keep fighting with my family. I have no energy for it anymore, I feel like I'll have a mental breakdown... And there is NCT. text: I want to watch this from a happy perspective, but I can't help but be sad as I imagine everything they've been through. Someone probably lost something important to them, love? possible life? time? other dreams? teenage years? happiness? These guys surely made a lot of sacrifices. Think about going to a foreign country, learning the language, not being able to communicate with the locals, and fitting in with their standards and way of life. It's as if you're entering the first stage of your life. Think about doing all the trainee things at a very young age. Others have been with the agency as trainees for years, and there must have been second thoughts and regrets during that time. I wonder what they went through to get to where they are now. author: @aniyah2435
text:
Came back here again after officially stanning NCT 5-6 months ago. Looking back, i want to thank them so much for cheering me on my bad days. They always give me a good laugh. They came to me right on the time. Time where I became so anxious about my future, don't know where I'm heading anymore. Little by little, i realized they became a small but important part of my life. My journey as an NCTzen hasn't been long, but it's already feel like I'm experiencing so many things with them. 

From Home is the starting point, where I'm starting to know them one by one. NCT2020 are the era where i did not experiencing fully but, it's an era where i couldn't move on till this day. It's an era where i will remember for a long time.

All i wanna say is, thank you NCT, thanks for everything, the memories, the experiences and the encouragements. I can't promise for being there until last, but i will be there for a long run. I hope you guys will enjoy the success after this without getting hurt.

author: @Anabsdjisnsbswi
text:
story of nct ~ actually I know them since debut and even pre-debut I guess…I remember at the beginning of 2016 I watched the video of the sm rookies and I was so surprised by ten’s beauty, there was even an article on korean platforms about ten as sm’s beautiful mysterious trainee. i remember lee soo man held a conference where he was talking about next boy group and that system of limitless members… everyone was so confused and even though they hadn't even debuted yet, everyone predicted a bad and flop future for them (a little did they know hehe) then a few months later the first unit of nct debuted - nct u with the 7th sense. oh god this song was literally the meaning of cultural reset, I remember how everyone were just shocked like it was something new and unusual to korean audience but they didn’t take this song well and I was so confused like why, it was literally the smoothest and the most addicting song I’ve ever heard, I was listening to it 24/7 for month it just was such a vibe and it still ofc. but I think they just weren't ready for changes, for something new in k-pop industry. sm might be a shitty company but in terms of songs and composition I think no one comes close to them, they really make music way ahead of the time, and 7th sense was one of this songs and limitless actually too. it’s sad that back then they didn’t receive the recognition they deserved. but look at them now, nct literally the biggest and the most popular brand out here, I bet now everyone talking about them, buying and listening their music 😏 and I’m so happy for them!!! literally those people who was talking bad about nct and their songs, now they don’t know what to do with themselves to look and sound like nct 😌 tbh I thought that these conversations about limitless members were a joke…but then not a long time after in the summer dremies and 127 debuted and then he appeared…that little boy named lee haechan oh lord if back then I know the grip that man will have on me in the future…but you know what interesting I heard his voice before I saw him in general. I mean the 7th sense was released before the official debut if I’m not wrong it was like a concept or trailer video of future boy group and there were taeyong, ten, mark, jaehyun and hansol dancing to this song and I remember the amount of times I watch this video just to listen this honey voice at the last part. and then an official music video was released but turns out that they re-recorded the song and that part…and I still didn’t know who it was till haechan debuted officially. that was my villain origin story, they literally cut the best part of this song, his voice just adds so much flavor, it’s something I can’t explain yeah
johnny and doyoung were added nct 127,  mark and haechan were in two units at the same time, then nct 2018 lucky three jungwoo, lucas and kun debuted, then in 2019 wayv debuted with the 3 new xiaohenyang and winwin too became a part of wayv, then all of sudden nct 2020 plus sungtaro and now 2021 😄 7dreamies with 2 cbs are done and now sm has a HUGE plans for next nct cbs idk they announced nct hollywood, nct 2021 plus 127, wayv cbs and even a new unit….oh gosh I know the second half of the year will be not boring at all, nctzens and wayshennies we’re booked and busy so prepare yourself mentally and physically :) I don’t know what to expect but one thing I know for sure is that all of nct units and members always work so hard to improve and show us their best, they deserve all the best things and praises in this world! and nct’s discography is literally the best in the whole k-pop industry, the fact that none of units have never released not even one bad song, it’s insane actually. I mean for their new music I expect nothing but bops and hits! 
stay safe <3

text: randomly watching this mv again really made me start thinking back about things and get emotional LMAO.  i remember a few months ago(about oct.-nov.), while being bored and seeing one of those random ass "funny kpop vids" in my recommended, and i clicked on it, at the time not being interested in kpop at all, knowing nothing about it and was a hater basically, and thinking how i would think the vid was cringey and weird as hell. but as i started watched it, i found myself lowkey smiling and cracking up at their jokes and personalities, so i went to see whatever group those guys were from, and they were from a group called "NCT". so later that night i watched at least 50 vids on them, learning their names, their positions and the different subunits, etc. and along the way, i could REALLY feel my love for them begin to blossom and grow more and more, and before i knew it, i was a kpop and NCT stan. but if i think back on it, i really regret not finding nct & enjoying kpop in general earlier. i was so close minded and hateful to things i thought were different and strange. but soon as i stepped outside my comfort zone, it felt like i was opened to a whole new world in a way tbh. and even though i discovered them very late, i feel like im connected them, every one of them, heart to heart. n this music video especially really makes me feel like ive known them forever. they have honestly changed my life :,) thank you nct, for everything <3.

author: @jademerald
text:
I'm claiming it: *The 7th Sense* will hit 100M in the next 24hrs. It was a long overdue goal, but to have it fulfilled now still means a lot.

It is a debut song that was so futuristic and daring that other rookies didn't want to try. The definition of unique, complex and beautiful. 

A masterpiece that represented NCT perfectly. The start of N-City. 

Us czennnies + weishennies are so lucky to be citizens of NCT. To have seen the neos grow then or to see them grow now. To have so much content and to know that they care for us. 

I don't think there's a better phrase than a simple "thank you" for expressing and giving us so much. Nctzens will continue to return it with support and love because it's simply deserved. That's why we're still here. 

Back then the neos probably didn't know how big they'd be or if they would still be a long term success. Back then they propably wanted to give up at times and back then they were much smaller. 

Now they are being looked up by people across the globe, they have titles such as "double million sellers" with growing records to their name. And they'll only get bigger.

More people will continue to wake up, open their eyes and fixate on the men wearing black. We'll have a new date on our calendar now :)

text:
Kalian ada dititik ini sekarang, karena kerja keras, pengorbanan dan kegigihan kalian. Kalian adalah orang-orang yang berani memperjuangkan impian kalian. Ya, aku yakin itu semua bukan proses instan tapi hasil dari kalian belajar dan berlatih secara bertahap.  Kalian bisa melewati dan terus bertahan menghadapi masa masa sulit, mungkin selama ini yang aku tahu hanya senyum dan air mata bahagia kalian. Karena kalian akan selalu menutupi kesakitan kalian demi membuat orang lain yang mencintai kalian tersenyum bahagia tanpa tau luka yang kalian rasakan.
Aku berterima kasih, karena kalian ada dan memberikan warna untuk kehidupan di kehidupan ku. Mungkin aku nggak bakalan bisa bertemu dan berterima kasih secara langsung dengan kalian. Tapi lewat perantara dunia maya, aku ingin kalian tau bagaimana cinta kalian yang kalian berikan itu bisa tersampaikan dengan baik kepada aku dan penggemar yang lain.  Ya, aku tau mungkin kalian nggak mengerti apa yang aku tuliskan disini. Tapi aku hanya ingin mengungkapkan bagaimana perasaan ku ketika menyaksikan kalian lewat dunia maya. 
Terima kasih, sungguh sangat terima kasih. Aku berharap semoga aku akan tetap bisa merasakan cinta dari kalian meskipun nanti waktu terus berjalan dan usia semakin bertambah. 
Terima kasih, sungguh sangat terima kasih sudah memberi cinta, kebahagiaan dan kenangan di usia ku yang sekarang. 
Semoga kalian selalu bahagia dan diliputi banyak cinta. Teruslah bertahan dan bahagia. Sehat selalu kalian semua. 
Terima kasih.  Dari aku yang menulis ini ditanggal 4/3/21.

Aku bahagia mengenal kalian secara tidak langsung dikehidupan ku.

I would like to thank my 17 year old self for stumbling across Taeyong's Open The Door video about 7 years ago, and for also being obsessed with EXO at the time to have watched EXO2014:90 as this was the show that introduced me to the new SM Rookies. They were those young boys showing up to do covers of 1st gen kpop and make cameos in the MVs EXO were recreating, but they have managed to get my attention, making me anticipate their 5 minutes of screentime within that 1 hour show more than I thought was possible. Now 7 years later, I am so proud to still be in the fandom, enjoying their music and their unlimited talents. Those 23 young men are too precious to me ❤🥺 The only group who can consistantly make me go back to kpop  and the group that never fails to amaze me. I knew it back that they were going to be my ultimate group one day and I wasn't wrong. Forever proud to be an NCTizen 💚

I’m a 21 year old man. This band was always recommended to me by my homeboy who was a year older. I’ve been a die-hard death metal fan my whole life and never had any interest in Kpop whatsoever. Homeboy was persistent, so early April I started listening to songs of NCT every late night while smoking, or getting drunk, or both. I grew to like this group a lot more than I expected. It’s been 7 months since homeboy passed because of brain complications, but I continue to follow this band in his honor; not because I feel like I have to, but it’s because I want to, for him, and for myself.

I love this btw. It helps me sleep. I miss my boys. Just felt like sharing my story to show how powerful NCT is.

I’m about to type a long ass comment so skip if u want...


As I was watching it hit me and it hit me so hard that I started crying out of nowhere.. all the NCT members didn’t have to go through all the training and every hardships that came with it especially the younger ones like jisung and chenle.. as we all know they all entered this entertainment at a young age like if u compare your age and theirs they where doing WAY more and just any kids their age(this goes to all the young trainees or idols out there) they really could have stayed home got to school have a normal life but their dream were way to big to just “live a normal life”  so they take on this journey going through it all.. the foreign members having to learn a whole different language and adapt to a whole different culture, having to leave their families and travel alone to this whole new country that now they call “home”. For me the purpose of this was them showing how they when from home, as in most of them had to laterally move from their homes, to home, which is where they are at now and as a group they creat a family which makes it feel like home even tho they aren’t him home(idk if that made sense). Like I keep saying they didn’t have to do all this but they WANTED they worked their way up to where they are right now with now members as they keep climbing.. and for y’all (Korean netizen mostly) to get butt hurt over EVERY little thing that y’all aren’t used to see like those pictures of jungwoo smoking makes me sad real sad.. y’all don’t know the pressure, stress and struggles they go through but y’all but first to comments on things as if y’all would even have to guts to do what they did and doing right now.. these boys( and all the kpop artists out there) have it hard you know.. they have to always put a smile on there face even if they don’t want to, always have to be perfect to be accepted in the publics eyes.. Some starting at a every young age mean they get to miss out on their whole childhood.. even haechan said it”it’s better to finish school and have a good childhood then enter the industry at a young age that’s one of my regrets” (or something similar).. I don’t know how NCT have impacted y’all’s lives but for me it was as if I found my own comfort zone through these boys.. Ik as cringe or whatever u may think it’s true like I’m not talking about just their music I’m saying this in general from their music videos to their UNCUT to just their VLIVEs these boys are special to me from Taeil to jisung. 


Ok I’m done but this really got me emotional 🤧

author: @yaydream5228
text:
the way these clips make me feel so many things for nct dream. they literally grew up together, and we were lucky enough to witness their growth as artists, a group and overall a family. 

they were children who have now grown up as young men and it’s quite refreshing to see. seeing the baby shinki clips are so nostalgic, but seeing pre-debut clips of the 5 boys that include renle hit differently. both renjun and chenle have previously mentioned how they watched sm rookies back as trainees and even before that (in renjun’s case). despite not debuting as rookies, they still ended up with mark, jeno, haechan, jaemin and jisung in nct dream. it was definitely fate. how all 7 boys found each other in nct dream. 

as a fan, i feel very proud seeing how much they’ve grown, and how much they’re rewarded and recognized for their talents and hard work. but on the other hand, i do still find it fucked up how flawed this system is to have put them through so much emotionally. (that also includes us, their supporters). dream usually gets the shortest end of the stick possible whenever they’re given a rushed comeback and little promotion. not to mention how much pain they probably went through back in 2018 with mark’s graduation, and last year during tds. 

there’s always an underlying uncertainty that comes with stanning dream. even the april 2020 announcement was vague as fuck. it’s honestly so emotionally tiring, but seeing things like this video, which is a literal proof of how they’ve grown, things fall to its place. i remember what made me fall in love with the group and the members in it, and everything becomes worth it in the end if it’s for dream. 

tldr; i just rambled. i really just want to say i love nct dream so much and they’re literally my source of happiness. 😭🥺

author: @ohanabii
text:
here's me being emotional (which i dont usually do):
for me, its crazy that i've known them since smrookies but only as a casual stan unfortunately TAT
(but i did try to learn their names without much subtitles back then haha)
i followed their comebacks casually from 7th sense to limitless (because im an sm group supporter hehehe)
i only started to know all of them by name after cherry bomb which was when i seriously started to get to know them more 
but i just feel sooo proud of them 
and seeing how they developed and how they rose above all the slander that was thrown at them since predebut, 
i feel so privileged to have seen them grow since they first started to now TT

i've never reaaally considered myself as part of any fandom before, maybe i was a casual shawol before, but other than that, i was only ever a casual fan of groups and only watched at an arms length away and followed to a certain extent, never ever engaging in anything, 
but im sooo invested in nct now and can literally say straight up that im an nctzen
they really made this year tolerable for me and seriously helped me get through it day by day... by daaaay~ (pun unintentional)

they all accomplished soo much this year and im sooo happy that i was able to witness everything in real time 
and shoutout to my ult bias haechan for working extreeeemely hard this year in 3 units actively (4 including nct 2020)
and secondary shoutout to mark, taeyong, lucas, and ten for working in 2 units (plus nct 2020) and superm
the boys all just seem sooo genuine, are genuinely friends, and try to get along with each other

text:
I do know that some of you guys, 127, Dreamies, WayV watch this video and dive into the comment section to read Sijeunies' comments. You know, i'm not best at confessing or expressing my feelings into words, but i hope you guys read mine. Can you see these clearly? Since Bubble and Twitter can't be the platforms that i could use to convey my feelings about you, so i hope it'll work here.

You know, i never regret the moment i started declaring myself as YUNO Orabeoni's fangirl since 2013, for the first time. I always remember the atmosphere and the euphoria from that time. That was so beautiful. I understood why Sijeunies gave YUNO Orabeoni a nickname "Everybody's First Love" it worked on me and i didn't believe in puppy love or first love until YUNO Orabeoni was introduced. Did SM like the Editors or Staffs read my conveyed feelings that i commented down in Nature Republic's vid on NCT DAILY? So they decided to do this and make so many Sijeunies even other fandoms crying out loud in silence? It would be hilarious. Thank you very much for whoever did have this kind of ideas of NCT's Past, Present and Future. I love you.

JUNG YUNO Orabeoni, you're more than perfect so it makes me feel so terrified for being your fangirl at very first time, for confessing what i feel about you and NCT, for being an ordinary girl who do supporting you from the very very very first. I feel like we've grown up together like a family. It's Heaven sent.

JUNG YUNO Orabeoni, thank you so much for always being my strength when things get harder, thank you so much for being one of the most precious ones of my life so far, thank you so much for working diligently and tirelessly for long ass ride years, thank you so much for being JAEHYUN onstage and JUNG YUNO offstage so perfectly, thank you so much for everything. You know, i've never had an older sibling, my older bro was gone even he still was a fetus, i thought Almighty God really love him so much. Watching fanmade videos, NCT's performance videos, really makes me realize that i extremely love you like my bro. Is it alright for you? Sijeunies said you wanted to have a Noona but i'm not that age ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ.

JUNG YUNO Orabeoni, i never can pay off your hardwork through years, i can't buy you expensive things, i can't buy you this world, i can't buy your happiness with my savings. Even i bought albums digitally and physically, it never can be enough to pay your teenage days. I'm so sorry if i can't protect you for real. I'm so sorry if i couldn't be by your side when you need someone to caress you, if i couldn't give my shoulders when you need someone to lean on, couldn't hug you and heal your pain right away, couldn't wipe your tears and sweats with my thumbs and fingers. But through this, i hope you'll see that i really love you like my Brother. Don't get exhausted. Don't get dehydrated. Don't be sad. Don't be stressed too much. Don't overthink on things. Don't make yourself feel uncomfortable for doing what you don't love. Go get your happiness. Do what you love and you're passionate at. Like what you yold us, Sijeunies. Arraseoyo?

Thank you so much for bringing me to your 22 Bros. It's so precious. In another world, i hope we can meet each other with the brightest smiles and the happiest faces. In the future, let's make more memorable and meaningful moments together with NCT, Sijeunies and our Families.


Sincerely love;

text: I've been a fan since the first smrookies members were revealed. Be a part of big agencies, doesn't mean their path to become an idol will be that easy but it also mean everyone will put on eyes to them and give them more burden because of expectation.

So let us support them harder because they also work hard to give their best to us!!

Apa kabar NCT,
Aku adalah NCTzen Indonesia ingin menyampaikan beberapa kalimat untuk kalian.
Terima kasih banyak kalian sudah bekerja keras sejak usia kalian masih belia. Aku tahu, rasanya pasti lelah. Benar kan? Tapi demi terwujudnya mimpi-mimpi kalian, kalian rela menghabiskan waktu sebagai trainee dan meninggalkan waktu belajar atau waktu bermain bersama teman-teman kalian.
Terima kasih sudah bersinar terang hingga sekarang atau mungkin selama-lamanya. Kuharap kalian selalu tetap bersama, selalu jaga kesehatan kalian, selalu berikan senyuman yang menawan, dan aku pun berjanji untuk selalu berada di belakang kalian memberi semangat dan menjadi tembok besar untuk menghalangi kalian agar kalian tidak jatuh.
Terima kasih NCT, kami sayang kalian.

ㅡBekasi Indonesia, 07 Desember 2020.

Bayangin dari kecil mereka sudah jadi trainee dari salah satu dari 3 Agensi terbesar di Korea Selatan. author: @zhaoren4275
text:
A revision of France's Bioethics Law advanced to the Senate in January 2020, when four senators submitted a bill to establish a registration system for French citizens who receive organ transplants abroad and to track the source of the organs. Awareness of forced organ harvesting and organ trafficking has recently increased in France.


The French Senate meets inside the Luxembourg Palace.

To draw attention to the law's revision, Falun Gong practitioners and human rights organizations rallied outside the Senate building on the afternoon of January 23.

France signed the Council of Europe Convention against Trafficking in Human Organs (CETS n°216) in November 2019 and became the 25th signatory country of the treaty.

“The treaty stipulated that it is a crime to take organs from living or dead bodies, in Europe and the rest of the world. This is a principle that France will defend, and we legislate our laws accordingly,” said Agnès Buzyn, la ministre française de la Santé.

Many senators expressed their concern that Falun Gong practitioners' organs were being forcibly taken by the Chinese communist regime.


Senator Oliver Cadic said that the Chinese government ignored the individual and his rights so it can take organs from people. “Obviously, this is totally inhuman. The topic [of organ harvesting] is very important because it violates the integrity of the human body,” he said.

text:
Sebuah perwujudan dari kata-kata 'Stan NCT for Better Life'.

Saya kira keputusan saya untuk mulai menyukai dan mencintai mereka adalah keputusan yang bagus, tapi saya salah. Karena keputusan saya untuk mencintai mereka adalah keputusan terbaik yang saya ambil, sejauh ini. Sebuah desakan aneh untuk mengeluarkan air mata tiba-tiba membuncah keluar, tanpa bisa saya tahan hanya untuk sekejap. Saya masih mencari mimpi saya, dan sepertinya sekarang saya tahu apa mimpi saya. Mimpi saya adalah agar saya dapat bergerak maju dengan usaha dan kerja keras saya sendiri. Mimpi saya adalah agar saya dapat bahagia dengan air mata yang saya keluarkan. Mimpi saya, adalah agar saya dapat dicintai banyak orang setelah orang-orang membenci saya. Mimpi saya bukanlah untuk terkenal, mimpi saya adalah agar saya dapat berguna-setidaknya untuk diri saya sendiri. Agar nanti saya dapat merasakan kebahagiaan ketika menyadari betapa berharganya air mata yang telah saya keluarkan dulu. Agar saya dapat tersenyum tulus saat melihat cermin.

Bogor, Indonesia 7 Desember 2020.
Terimakasih kepada 23 lelaki yang selalu membuat hari saya dipenuhi kebahagiaan dan kepercayaan akan hari esok.

I was already in a psychiatric hospital when one of the nurses told me with a smile "your mom brought you a gift" I opened it and it was all the versions of RESONANCE.. Remembering internal jokes from NCT and from us, NCTzens, made me come back to reality and want to be better to go back to living my day to day. NCT and NCTZENS are what I will always treasure in my heart because they always bring me joy and calm whenever I need it. I hope this family continues growing up and I hope these 23 hard working guys always have good memories and remember that there are millions of people that are proud of all of them....

text: The best part of stanning NCT from their debut was to see them grow ! They received hate since 2016 and even before since SMrookies era but they got through with it because they had each other. I am proud to say I'm an NCTzens, a Czennie, grass, (a clown). It started years ago and NCT is like a first love or first experience in life, you cannot forget about it. I will forever be grateful to them for the happiness they brought into my life, the smile they put on my face, the tears of joy I shed when they won a award or on a music show. We are strangers to them to be honest but for some of us they are our saviours, our guiding angels. Every year since 2016, NCT had new members and this means we have more people to give our love to, new members to take care of. Czennies !!! Our journey is far from over, this is just the beginning and we need to trust the members, love them, cry with them, smile with them and enjoy our lives even when we cannot see them because they will always have a place in our hearts. Thank you <3 <3

text: More than anything From Home is truly speaking about the story of the members and especially the foreign members of NCT. As a big group of 23 filled with people of different cultures and backgrounds, who speak different languages, as well as being a group that is subjected to so many changes, I think the reason why they are able to thrive and the very concept of NCT is able to become a success is because of the genuine love and respect they have for each other. They embrace their differences and they appreciate their differences. They love and respect one another and they’re considerate towards each other. They make foreign members feel loved and they never fail to make the newer members feel welcomed. They truly help one another out here and there. NCT are genuinely nice and warm people and that’s why the foreign members have so much love for NCT, it is because of the BOND they have with each other and the love they have for each other that helps them overcome their loneliness of being in a foreign country. Because damn, it really isn’t easy being away from home. Their members have become their family members and that’s why NCT is home to them. Like what doyoung said, they are from different places yet they gathered here as NCT because they have the same dreams. This is what the lyrics of From Home are talking about, “I have a reason to be myself, know that you are not alone anymore”💚 NCT is home.

Yes, I'm 15000% behind this!! Everyone was saying how we were still overshadowed by EXO, their senior, and BTS becoming more popular globally. It didn't matter. It DOESN'T matter. This group will forever be special and important and all of their messages and interactions, the memes and the hilarity, the lows and the losses, and even the wins - all of that is forever immortalised in our NCTzen hearts. This has been the only group to make me feel some type of way. 

I remember at their debut, when the limitless concept was introduced, this fandom had SOOOO much flack from the k-pop community online. They thought we were not going to do well and tbh, I used to stay up wishing we had a millions wins and a billion views.

Now? I seriously don't give a fuck. This group brings amazing music, amazing content, chemistry and diversity and that's all we can really ask for.

One of the best decision that I ever made was to stan NCT.  They are literally the first group that I stanned (I have never had an ounce of regret with the decision). I want to take a moment to thank every single member ot23. Thank you for your hard work, dedication, and love towards your ART. Watching the original version of From Home made me cry, but while I watched this video I literally sobbed. 

I RESONATED with the video because it reminds me a lot of myself. I even had a flash back to the very first time I stepped into my current country of residence (foreign land) to study at the University at 16yrs alone not knowing anyone. It is really hard to live far away from your family and friends especially at such a young age. But you have to think about the bright future ahead.

Thank you for taking the brave step towards achieving your dream. After watching the video and sobbing, I went through every single old pictures of mine; I felt grateful and sobbed more.
Thank you to the people that recorded this video, I am positive that the members will look back and feel even more emotions than they did today.

With that been said: NCTZENS we need to do our part too, promote and make them shine: Str**m, purchase Albums, we need them charting everywhere at least to repay their labour. Although NCT2020 is ending, subunits will be active next year so lets make history, have fun, and enjoy the music and the ride.

Thank you NCT, Thank you NCTZENS, have a wonderful holiday and see you in the new year.

text: I don’t think many people and especially the non fans really understand what NCT have been through. While many people love to discredit NCT’s success because of their concept and the huge number of members they have, actually their very concept was and still is what made it difficult for them. text:
Dear NCT, 
It's been 2 years and a half since you became a big part of my life. As an Nctzen i lived the happiest moments of my life, and i can't thank you enough for existing and for giving us the power and the strength to keep going every day through your music. 
I remember like it's yesterday how I was watching "kpop try not to sing videos" in June 2018 and I was wondering why there are so many Ncts, like why they are "127" "U" and "Dream". I was so confused at first. And so randomly I started to watch more videos because I got curious. And I watched Weekly Idol with all the 18 members that were then. I was shocked... 18 members... so many. What a little fool I was...
I felt in love with you, your concept, your faces, how you are a big group with many sub units and so on...it was something crazy and new for me. I got my first bias, Mark. Then I started to watch more and more videos with you. I chose Lucas as my bias too, after that Jaeminie, Ten and Jaehyun got into my bias list... I stopped there :))
I am so happy because I was able to see WayV's debut, YangYang, Hendery and Xiaojun getting into Nct... I was there for you at every single comeback since August 2018. I was there when Winwin was with 127 and Mark with the dreamies all the time... I was there to see Jungwoo debuting with 127 and Kun becoming a leader... 
And also Shotaro and Sungchanie coming into our amazing family. 
I did it all, I watched you growing up, I cried with you and I laughed like crazy because of you... 
I am so happy to be an Nctzen, I can't imagine my life without you boys. To all, 23 members, I want to say that I love each one of you and I am blessed to have you in my life.
And in the name of millions of Nctzens I want to say:
NCT, THANK YOU FOR BECOMING OUR HAPPINES EVERYDAY. WE LOVE YOU! 
with all the love in the world, a Romanian Nctzen.

text: From Home has to be one of the most meaningful songs from NCT that speaks so much about NCT. From Home speaks about the foreign members of NCT who came from far away, some even from the orher side of the planet all the way to korea to pursue their dreams. It speaks about the difficulties and inevitable loneliness they face being in a completely new country. NCT has more foreigners than Korean citizens and yet all of them love NCT, all of them love each other. This can be seen in the pride and live they have for being an NCT member. And this is all because of the mutual love they have for one another. Their members are their friends and their family, and NCT is their home away from home. Like doyoung said, all of them come from different places and speak different languages. All of them joined NCT at different timings. But NCT is NCT because of all of them and all of them are gathered together because of their dreams. And that’s why for NCT members, NCT is truly home💚

author: @jqxx2538
text: I honestly love NCT so much. No number of albums sold or awards we get will ever be as precious as the bond NCT has and the love they have for each other and the love they have for US, the fans. Many people may have doubts about what NCT is like as a big group. Do they know each other? Is this concept even going to work? But let me tell you these guys are some of the sweetest people ever and that NCT is a big FAMILY. This limitless expansion concept would not work out if it’s not for the LOVE they have for one another. For one, they love and welcome their foreign members. Living in a foreign country and being away from home is really not easy, which is why many foreign kpop idols end up leaving, but for NCT you can truly see the love and pride they have for being an NCT member. They love NCT because the members are their family members, and NCT is their home. They respect and appreciate everyone. And secondly, they always welcome the new members. They always make an effort to welcome them and make them feel welcomed and love. That is why the lyrics of from home goes “and i have a reason to be myself, know that you are not alone anymore”. There must be a lot of love, respect, and consideration among them for them to thrive as a big group and for them to overcome their loneliness of being in a foreign country. And this is why NCT is their home. All of them are from different places and speak different languages, but all of them have come together as NCT because they have the same dreams. NCT is their home that’s away from their home💚 that’s why like the song says, it all starts from home.

text:
To NCT,

Some people said that ‘your idols don’t even know your existence, why put so much into them?’ . How i wish I could tell them that being a fan is not only about liking their visual, talents and ‘merely entertainment’. Thank you for having a dream that we can share together. When you found your home in the members, we found our home from all of you. It doesn’t matter how others say about this ‘love’ towards you guys, but for me you’re someone that hold big part of me. Teach me about loves, family, being strong together, be there for each other. Watching you guys growing up together and working hard as ever, makes me forget that idols, are human too. Please be happy, no matter what. Do everything that you love. Don’t fall sick. Eat properly. We can only just say that from a far. Thank you for being one of the biggest part of my life. Lets walk through this path together for the long time.


Thank you for being my home,

💚💚💚

I've been with #NCT ever since they first introduced the 1st batch of #SMROOKIES. They were the 1st group (SMROOKIES now known as Red Velvet and NCT) I've seen from the beginning (I started stanning previous sm groups a few months or a year after they've debuted). I remember all those moments that I had to check any updates from the members, the sad feeling of not being in South Korea to watch their SMROOKIES show, the saddest moment knowing Hansol left SM ENT, and a lot more. text: Comebacklerle, livelarla, kazandığınız her ödülde bize teşekkür edişinizle mükemmeldiniz. Bizi değerli hissettirdiğiniz için, bunca zamandır verdiğiniz emekler için çok teşekkür ederim. İnsanların bana karşı düşüncelerini aldırmadan verebildiğim kararların, yaşadığım büyük şeylerin altından küçük yaşta kalkabilmemin, sıkıcı ve üzücü olayları aldırmamamın nedeni olduğunuz için teşekkür ederim. Her zaman en iyisini hak ediyorsunuz, çocukluğunuzdan beri verdiğiniz emekler emin olun ki milyonlarca insana destek oldu, ilham oldu. author: @jatj0t825
text:
to have all these boys come from different walks of life from all corners of the world, the stories of how their passion made them audition, how they were casted or simply how a dream made them want to audition. how so many of them had to give up things normal people like us would easily take for granted as we went through our teenage years. the hardships they had to go through, and still face to get where they are today are things we can't ever imagine or understand. sometimes the boys tell us how much they've worked hard and yes we are well aware of that but sometimes i find that i tell myself that we don't truly know what that whole process must be like, what kind of emotions and challenges each of them face individually. one thing's for sure is that it surely can't be easy. each time they are given a new opportunity, be it a comeback or even a performance, a concert. they're always striving to perfect the stage and perform better than their last. it's that immense dedication and direction to want to give nothing but the best, and the amount of sweat, toil and tears that come outfrom doing so that i truly admire and respect the boys for. more so the fact that for most of them they've been doing it for almost half their lives. in some way sometimes it's heartbreaking the way they had to give up a life of normalcy and had to mature early, go through hardships many of us will never understand. but if anything i'm glad that fate found its way to bring these people together because they all have that same fire and strength to want to do this, and most importantly is the fact that such people like them have been brought together just like this. saying nct is fate sometimes sounds kind of cheesy maybe a bit ridiculous...but it really feels that way to me. they're like some puzzle set yet to be completed and with every coming member their wonderful one-of-a-kind dynamic simply allows this family to grow beautifully. of course on sm's side there's still a lot of shit they have to get right, but between and within units, you cany deny the bond these members have. i just think that's the most precious thing and is what makes me love nct so much... i don't do that easily and nct is really the first group i've chosen to properly stan since starting to like kpop back in 2011. they really mean so much to me.

i wasn't there from the start but nct has never had it easy from the beginning...the concept the mistreatment, public response and antis here and there but seeing their success as of recent makes the win so much more sweeter. as much as they've grown, so many of us have been able to do the same, have been inspired by them, have received so much happiness from them. and for that nct wayv...we are just so immensely proud of your accomplishments. it is due to your hard work, the love you have for what you do, the strength and the family you've found in each other. to all 23 of you you've ALWAYS done well, you've always made us proud, you've always made us feel happy and loved. for who you are ncti'm certain many more sunny days are coming your way. we love you always!! thank you nct

author: @jiyuong
text:
NCT was the result of more than a decade of trial and error by SM. They tried to achieve this with Super Junior at first with Super Junior, Super Junior M, Super Junior Happy, Super Junior KRY..

Tried it again with EXO.. M and K and later on CBX, Sehun and Chanyeol..

Even tried mixing groups together like SM The Ballad.. 

Then really put their foot down and delivered when NCT as a concept was announced by Lee Soo Man in one of his keynotes.

It was a mix of everything. The right generation, the right contracts and working conditions (we all know who to thank for that),  the right casting method and global auditions, training and conditioning, branding and marketing and most importantly, the right talent with the right attitude and belief in the system.

NCT, the artists, prove that putting the hard work and determination behind the vision makes it possible. NCT really had to set their egos aside for this to succeed and keep a mindset of cheering everyone on no matter what year you debut.

NCT is brilliant and will live on because they are stronger together.

Thanks for coming to my Ted Talk.

text:
Dear NCT,
I'm sure being part of group whose concept the world finds hard to understand must've been tough, but all of you'll overcame it with having the same goal while supporting each other and working hard. Thank you so much for not losing hope and following your dream, because of which we got to meet you'll. 23 wonderful, hard-working, beautiful and kind boys. You've brought so much happiness to your fans all around the world. Listening to your songs, watching your performances or just watching a video of you'll goofing around has given me the strength to get over difficult nights countless times. So thank you for coming into our lives and brightening them, we're so lucky to have you. To the foreign members, I can't imagine how hard it must've been to leave your home and come train in an unfamiliar country, but I'm so grateful you'll pushed through while your members supported you. All of you'll have worked so hard in the past years and I know will continue to in the future, so just know that us Czennies/Wayzennies are so extremely proud of you'll and will always be here to support you guys in every way possible. Difficult times may come but we'll always be here through them and at the end of them. I hope we can provide some solace to you'll during those times. 
And finally, thank you for becoming our home 💚
Stay safe and take care of your health everyone. Waiting for a chance to see you perform on stage while being a part of the green ocean waving our neobong with pride.
- a proud Nctzen 💚

author: @vegaselviyana553
text:
Thank you for everything, thank you for everything you've done lately. Do I feel excessive or is this what I feel.

I love you all so much, I love everything about you especially your laughter and your smiles even though I don't know whether you're really happy when you smile and laugh like that?

I felt so alive when I saw you, I always hoped to satisfy you because I was so satisfied with what you did. All without exception.

It seemed like only yesterday when I was so surprised that I made people at home also surprised at my voice. It feels like yesterday when I see so many articles saying that there's 2020 NCT, imagine my exam tomorrow but news keeps surfacing in my mind.

You're so full of surprises, everything you do feels like something new doesn't bother me to keep following you, even though I don't know when this will all be over, when you've become unattractive to me. Let's hope it never happened.

You guys know? When I was down, all I did was look at you, look at you. Somehow it feels like you guys are here to calm me down and try to make me laugh.
 
I was so happy when you were on stage, I wanted a moment to stop so I could put your face in my mind. I'm glad to see that whatever you do is important you keep smiling.
 
I'm sorry if that sounds selfish but, uh, I wish it would go on forever, even if it sounded impossible.

I'm happy to know these 23 people. No remorse is embedded in me. Thank you so much for making others happy when you can't make yourself happy. I hope you'll remain friends with the absence of the NCT.

My greetings

J Sjha

December 6, 2020 8:07 am

I woke up with my dog's sudden death. It gives me a major heartache to the point that I want to scream in sorrow. But with a heavy heart, I need to accept that she was gone that I need to move on. I love her since 2014 and I treated her like my best friend and my sister since I don't have one. It just pains me that everything is new to me now. No one's going to send me off when I'm leaving. No one's gonna be there when I call her name. No one's gonna be there to guard us, to protect us, give us warning and assurance that we're safe.

I received this vid notif and I know by watching this makes me cry. I haven't cried fully up until now. And it literally takes an hour for me to decide if I'm going to watch or not.

This song gives me comfort. Flashbacks from what I've been through thru the years. So thank you to these song for letting me release this heavy feeling on my chest.

Fly high in paradise, my Tabi. You will always be in my memories. Rest well. I love you always and forever.

Thank you NCT for this masterpiece 💚

author: @eithapreasysembiring8959
text:
To : NCT

Maaf aku baru mengenal dan mengikuti kalian sejak awal tahun ini. Maaf jika aku tidak bisa merasakan suka duka bersama kalian sejak awal. Tapi, terimakasih atas kehadiran kalian dalam hidupku. Kalian memberi warna yang sangat aku dambakan selama ini. Kalian juga menjadi penyemangatku untuk melewati masa pandemi ini yang cukup berat bahkan berat jika ku lewati sendirian. Berkat kalian juga aku selalu punya motivasi untuk menjadi diri sendiri, belajar menjadi pribadi yang lebih baik lagi dan selalu bersyukur atas apa yang diberikan Tuhan. Terimakasih atas kerja keras kalian semua, 23 orang yang ku kasihi dan ku sayangi. Kalian selalu memberikan yang terbaik sekalipun keadaan kalian tidak mendukung/tidak berdaya. Kalian tidak pernah berniat untuk mengecewakanku dan semua penggemar kalian. Kami NCTZEN, sangat bangga menjadi bagian dari penggemar dan supporter kalian.
Dan, aku memang tidak menemani kalian dari awal, tapi aku akan berusaha semampuku untuk bertahan dengan pilihan hati ini, sampai akhir nanti.
Goodbye NCT 2020, Welcome All Happy Memories Mulai dari Tahun 2021 nanti sampai selamanya.
Ayo lewati segala tantangan dan hambatan bersama :)

English
Sorry I just got to know and follow you since the beginning of this year. Sorry if I couldn't feel the joys and sorrows with you from the start. But, thanks for your presence in my life. You guys gave me the color that I've been dreaming of. You have also encouraged me to go through this pandemic which is quite heavy even if I pass it alone. Thanks to you, I always have the motivation to be myself, learn to be a better person and always be grateful for what God has given me. Thank you all for your hard work, 23 people whom I love and care about. You always give your best even if your circumstances are not supportive / helpless. You never intended to disappoint me and all of your fans. We, NCTZEN, are very proud to be part of your fans and supporters.
And, I did not accompany you from the beginning, but I will try my best to endure this heart's choice, until the end.
Goodbye NCT 2020, Welcome All Happy Memories starting from 2021 until forever.
Let's go through all the challenges and obstacles together :)

Korean
올해 초부터 알려 드려 죄송합니다. 당신의 기쁨과 슬픔을 느끼지 못하면 미안합니다. 하지만 내 인생에있어 주셔서 감사합니다. 내가 꿈꾸던 색을 줬어. 이 매우 심각한 전염병을 통해 나를 돕고 있습니다. 나는 홀로 설 수 없다. 여러분 덕분에 저는 항상 제 자신이되고, 더 나은 사람이되는 법을 배우고, 하나님 께서 저에게 주신 것에 대해 항상 감사 할 의욕이 있습니다. 열심히 일 해주신 모든 분들, 제가 사랑하고 아끼는 23 분께 감사드립니다. 좋지 않더라도 항상 최선을 다합니다. 저와 제 모든 팬들을 실망시킬 의도는 없습니다. 저희 NCTZEN은 여러분의 팬이자 서포터임을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다.
처음부터 동행하지는 않았지만이 마음의 선택을 끝까지 견디기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다.
안녕하세요 NCT 2020, 2021 년부터 영원히 사랑하는 모든 추억에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
모든 도전과 장애물을 함께 극복합시다 :)

Chinese
抱歉，我是今年年初才认识您的。 对不起，如果我不感到您的喜悦和悲伤。 但是感谢我的生活。 你给了我我梦of以求的颜色。 您正在帮助我度过这个非常严重的流行期。 我不能一个人站立。 谢谢，我一直有成为自己的动力，学会做一个更好的人，并始终感谢上帝给我的一切。 感谢所有辛勤工作的人，我爱护和关心的23个人。 即使情况不好，您也总是尽力而为。 无意让我和所有粉丝失望。 NCTZEN，我们非常荣幸成为您的粉丝和支持者。

让我们一起克服所有挑战和障碍:)

NCT is the beginning of this new direction of K-Pop. When other popular artists only focusing on being more popular, NCT mark the start of a new project that never been done or even imagined by others. Surely we'll always be amazed by SM's visionary and futuristic ideas and works.

Please keep supporting NCT! This is just a beginning, cuz they'll definitely rule this world!

text:
Terima kasih banyak NCTzen, NCT 127, NCT Dream, Wayv, NCT U, 2020 ini menjadi lebih luar biasa. Baru kali ini bela-belain ikutan stream di acara award, stream semua variety show, ikutan stream party, segala sesuatu tentang NCT dijelajah. Belum lagi ketemu Sijeuni/wayzenni yang ramah - ramah. Banyak banget dan sering banget kalian (NCT) memberikan persembahan kepada kami, mencurahkan segala tenaga demi yang terbaik, dan lagi yang beraktivitas bukan hanya di satu grup saja. Aku stan baru dari tahun 2019 akhir, setahun setelahnya ke ikutan projek 2020 ini, bener-bener seneng banget. Aku ga akan memungkiri, emang awalnya sulit, sulit banget nginget NCT. Terlalu banyak unit, terlalu banyak member, memang. Tapi seiring waktu, semakin tau, semakin mengenal, yang dulunya ribet malah jadi menyenangkan dan akhirnya keasyikan sama NCT. Sungguh teramat sangat berkesan. Terima kasih atas kerja keras kalian semua.

4:16 terharu banget, se-terbuka itu NCT sama member yang baru bergabung. Excited banget semua merayakan. Pastinya berkesan juga buat Shotaro, di tahun pertama masuk NCT keikutan projek besar, dan dapat member yang ikut mendukung dan membantu dia dalam segala hal, belajar bahasa, belajar mengenal korea, secara perlahan. Beruntungnya juga ada Yuta yang sama-sama dari Jepang, sehingga culture shock Shotaro dapat sedikit lebih mereda (?). 

"Kehangatan bagai rumah" kalian terasa, kalian telah sukses menyampaikannya. we love you :)

author: @hyerom_323
text:
지금 오직 내가 이 영상을 보고 할 수 있는 일이 우는 것과 내가 정말 좋아하고 있는 사람들을 응원하는 것 밖에 못한다는게 정말 안타깝다. 각자의 꿈 하나를 위해서 누군가는 타지에서 가족과의 만남을 뒤로한 체 이 자리에 오고, 누군가는 자신의 학창시절을 뒤로 한체 이 자리에 왔다. 한가지, 가수가 되겠다는 단 한가지의 꿈을 위해 이 모든 시련과 고난을 겪어왔고, 더 성장하고 발전하기 위해서 데뷔 후에도 엄청난 노력을 해왔다는 것은 안 봐도 알 수 있는 내용이다. 우리도 마찬가지이다. 엔시티의 팬으로서, 그리고 엔시티가 아니더라고 누군가의 팬으로 살아가는 것은 그 한 사람, 또는 한 팀을 위해서 엄청난 애정을 쏟는 거라고 할 수 있다. 그들이 우리에게 좋은 노래로 행복을 주려고 노력하듯이, 우리도 그들에게 응원과 힘을 주어 그들에게 힘이 되어주려 노력하고 있다. 엔시티가 데뷔한 후 5년차가 된 지금까지, 엔시티 각 멤버들이 포기한것과 지금까지 노력한 것, 그리고 엔시티즌의 응원이 있었기에 음원 차트 1위, 음악방송 1위, 그에 더 나아가 대상까지 받을 수 있었다. 항상 좋은 것만 보고 좋은 것만 들으라고 얘기하지만 그게 쉽지 않은 것, 정말 잘 안다. 언제까지 자신에게 좋은 것만 받아 들일 수 없으니깐.  지금 이 댓글을 단 이후에 어떤 멤버가 이 글을 볼지 모르겠지만, 누군가에겐 4년동안, 누군가에겐 2년동안, 그리고 누군가에겐 몇주동안 이 자리에 오기까지 정말 수고 많았단 말 전해주고 싶고, 수많은 소수의 질타에도 무너지지 않으려 노력하며 엔시티즌의 응원으로 이 자리까지 굳건하게 견뎌와준 그들에게 정말 고맙단 말 해주고 싶다. 엔시티가 있어서 하루하루 행복하고, 엔시티가 있기에 하루하루가 정말 소중하다. 한 때 엔나나에서 도영이가 했던 말이 지금까지 떠나가질 않았다. 행복은 '강도'가 아니라 '빈도'라고. 행복이 얼마나 단번에 크게 오느냐가 아니라 얼마나 자주 오는지에 따라 정말 행복한지 아닌지 알 수 있다고 했던 말을 아직도 잊지 못한다.  당신들이 내 행복의 빈도 중 대부분을 차지하고 있고, 덕분에 하루하루가 행복하다고 말해주고 싶었다. 오늘을 기점으로, 더 많은 사람들이 엔시티를 알고, 더 많은 엔시티즌이 생겨, 더 많은 행복을 나눴으면 좋겠다. 
그리고 한마디 더 하자면, 우리들 중에 목표를 가지고 있는 사람도 있을 것이고, 목표를 가지지 않은 사람도 있을것이다. 그러나 궁극적으로 우리 모두 확실하지 않아도 어느 한 점을 향해서 달려나가고 있다. 학업이든, 취업이든, 직장에서의 일이든, 잠깐 동안은 괴로울 수 있으나 상황을 멀리 내다보고 굳건히 견뎠으면 좋겠다. 물론, 너무 견디기 힘들다면 쉬어도 좋다. 하지만, 포기는 하지 말자. 포기를 하는 순간 내가 성공할 수 있는 기회 자체를 소멸시키는 거니까. 우리들의 뮤즈 엔시티가 이룬 것처럼, 굳건히 견디며 한 점을 향해 나아가다보면, 어느새 성공이라는 결말에 도달해 있을거라고 말하고 싶었다. 태일, 쟈니 ,태용,유니, 쿤, 도영, 텐,재현,윈윈,정우,루카스,마크, 샤오쥔,헨드리,런쥔,제노,해찬,재민,양양,쇼타로,성찬,천러,지성! 이때까지 열심히 달려오느라 수고 많았고, 앞으로도 우리와 함께 더 열심히 달려나가자!!!정말 수고 많았고, 오늘 하루는 모두가 푹 쉬길...! text: keeping up with them ever since the day taeyong was introduced as smrookies until right now is probably one of the best decisions i’ve ever made in my life, well it sounds cheesy but it’s true nevertheless. i’ve been there since day 1, and i’ve seen their improvements throughout the years and how people doubted them by calling them “SM’s flop”, but look at them now. it’s surely a ‘long ass ride’ isn’t it? dear taeil, jhonny, taeyong, yuta, kun, doyoung, ten, jaehyun, winwin, jungwoo, lucas, mark, xiaojun, hendery, renjun, jeno, haechan, jaemin, yanyang, chenle, jisung, shotaro and sungchan, thank you for your hard work and your genuine passion of being performers and artists, thank you for lighting our world up either with your music, performance or any contents you’ve given us. i’m very proud of you guys, i can’t imagine how hard it is to sacrifice your youth, to leave your home (or even country for the foreign members) and to spend countless times of practicing. you deserve all the love and support (and the investment from SM’s investors) and i hope you can grow and get more recognition you deserve but at the same time i hope you’ll have enough time to take a break and take care of yourself after this tiring but exciting nct 2020 project, because as much as i want to see you on the stage, your health is the most important. i love you guys so freaking much and i won’t stop supporting you even though you don’t know i exist but that’s besides the point lol. keep up the good work, stay strong, don’t forget to take care of yourselves and please, take care of each other as well. definitely looking forward for what you’re going to show us in your next comebacks!

author: @abcde6870
text:
Dear NCT,
I'm sure being part of group whose concept the world finds hard to understand must've been tough, but all of you'll overcame it with having the same goal while supporting each other and working hard. Thank you so much for not losing hope and following your dream, because of which we got to meet you'll. 23 wonderful, hard-working, beautiful and kind boys. You've brought so much happiness to your fans all around the world. Listening to your songs, watching your performances or just watching a video of you'll goofing around has given me the strength to get over difficult nights countless times. So thank you for coming into our lives and brightening them, we're so lucky to have you. To the foreign members, I can't imagine how hard it must've been to leave your home and come train in an unfamiliar country, but I'm so grateful you'll pushed through while your members supported you. All of you'll have worked so hard in the past years and I know will continue to in the future, so just know that us Czennies/Wayzennies are so extremely proud of you'll and will always be here to support you guys in every way possible. Difficult times may come but we'll always be here through them and at the end of them. I hope we can provide some solace to you'll during those times. As much as I will miss this era, I can't wait for what the future holds for us. Love you guys so much.
And finally, thank you for becoming our home 💚
Stay safe and take care of your health everyone. Waiting for a chance to see you perform on stage while being a part of the green ocean waving our neobong.
- a proud Nctzen 💚

text: Aku beneran baru pertama kali merasakan ini. Mendukung mereka sejak awal, dan ngerasain susah senang bareng2 rasanya. Setiap ditanya temen, "Grup yang kamu suka apa?" Dengan seneng, tentunya aku jawab "NCT" dan mereka bingung terheran2. Munafik kalo aku bilang aku biasa aja, aku bener2 sedih rasanya kalo ada orang yang bilang, "Siapa tuh?" Ke idolku. Sampai akhirnya aku bener2 fangirling sendirian, teman2 yg lain sibuk juga dengan yang lain. Aku rasa itu adalah hal lumrah, mereka baru debut dan wajar ga banyak yang tau. Sampe akhirnya NCT 2018, aku masih sendirian nontonin mereka di pojokkan kelas. Banyak yang bilang mereka gagal, gak bakal sukses kayak seniornya. Sedih banget rasanya. Dan seiring berjalannya waktu, seringkali aku denger orang nyebutin nama mereka. Srringkali aku denger ada yang setel lagu mereka. Dan sekarang, melihat mereka udah sukses, kalian tau kan gimana perasaan aku? Seseneng dan sebangga itu. Gak bohong, aku selalu nangis ketika liat video zaman dulu mereka, liat foto predebut mereka bareng2. Aku nangis. Dan ga pernah ga nangis. Karena aku tau, mereka bener2 berjuang dapetin itu. Mereka bener2 berjuang untuk memperkenalkan ke seluruh dunia, bahwa mereka adalah NCT. Mereka semua sudah berusaha keras, walau mereka berbeda waktu mulai semuanya. Mereka selalu melakukan yang terbaik untuk kita. Dan mereka semua sangat pantas untuk dicintai. Kita udah berjuang bareng. Pasti banyak hal yang udah kita lalui bareng. Saling memberi kasih sayang yaa. We start from here, our home. 💚

text: In 2019 I met NCT through funny videos of them, but I didn't know them at all, their history or their songs. I kept following NCT because even though I saw their funny videos, I fell in love with those videos and those personalities. Two months ago my 20 year old brother passed away. I couldn't sleep, I was so broken. Every time I thought about my brother or what had happened I got a sharp pain in my chest, I don't know where it was, but I know that it was a pain that went through my whole chest, my heart, my soul and body hurt so much that I didn't want to feel it anymore. To keep my mind off of it, I kept watching YouTube or Netflix. On YouTube I watched NCT videos again and wow, the only thing that has kept me safe so far has been NCT. I'm new to being NCTzen, but NCT, on the emotional side, they mean a lot to me. NCT thank you for saving me, for saving me from loneliness. This song also means a lot to me. The right song at the right time. Thank you NCT for even though you were not with me in person, you never left me alone in the moments when sadness abounded. Thank you, NCT, thank you very much. I wish you the biggest success in the world, bigger than the one you have now. "Know that you are not alone anymore" absolutely. THANK YOU!

author: @haechanradioenthusiast9015
text:
Thank you, NCT. I honestly don't know why am I writing this in a freaking youtube comment section of all things, but I guess sometimes people are too emotional, and they slip.
I want to thank you, for being people I can look up to at my dark times, for being people who will always glow, no matter how disgusting everything around gets. I admire you guys for chasing after your dreams even though they get smaller and smaller with time, even though reality sucks out all the pretty fairytales you had hoped for. It gives me, and many of us the courage to chase after our own, because no matter how bad the outcome is, this chase, this leap towards the distance will change us. Even if we don't reach our destination, we'd still have travelled towards it, without giving up. I thank all of you, especially NCT Dream, as I can somehow still find remains of my mundane in your stardom. NCT 127, because adulthood has not taken away your soul, and my terror to reach it finds consolation in you. WayV, for still being yourself, even when all around you are different, for having the courage to keep your persona intact. Thank you for being who you are. Thank you for creating music in a thousand spheres and tangents, for letting it stretch out as wide as the human mind can go. Please, never lose hope, and never give up. All of you mean a lot to all of us. Thank you, and all the best. 💚

author: @jhyns
text: THIS IS THEIR BEST PERFORMANCE/RELEASE IN THEIR WHOLE CAREER. I really can’t put into words how amazing it was. This song was about fear & loneliness and eventually finding peace and love from those around them. Knowing NCT’s concept and how a lot of them are foreigners and had to move away from their families to pursue their dream, this story resonates with them so much. The members also said thank you in their foreign language in the mv. When they added all the foreign members, I couldn’t help but cry because of how much they dedicated their life into what they do. Imagine the loneliness of moving to a different country and not the language. Foreign members also shared stories of how their fellow nct members helped them in learning korean. It also showed some videos of their rookie days huhu. This was like a moment of appreciation for them and their hard work. Don’t even get me started on the vocal performance. Indeed, SM groups are the best in that field and all the high notes and adlibs that were added to this already amazing ballad track was insane. This was truly beautiful and profound, NCT 🥺. Stanning them since debut has been the best decision. And to Doyoung, Taeil, and Haechan. No words. Everyone was amazing but you three proved how vocally well-versed their group is and I’m so proud of that.

author: @YellaineFukuto27
text:
As someone who have been a fan of the boys since SMROOKIES roughly 2014, this video made me cry a lot. Like, a lot. There were those days when we have to wait each passing day to get some updates about the boys. We used to get menpa from them every once in a while and it already made us so happy. Sometimes, waiting takes days, weeks and sometimes months. They were trainees back then and its so hard to get updates about them. SMROOKIES SHOW was definitely the turning point of that time and we knew, they will debut soon. It also hurt us a lot when we found out Hansol left SM. (I know he is doing well now, I’m happy for him)

Now, they are NCT. We also have a lot of new members and family. The way that they consider us their home makes me cry so much because I am so happy that I sticked with them through the good times and the bad. This feeling, of being spoiled of so much NCT content has always been a luxury that most fans tend to take for granted. I love them so much. This year has been very awful but NCT really did make it better. 

Their music has always been my refuge and comfort. Thank you so much, NCT.
